facts.text: The new Pulsar N250SS is priced at ₹1,59,406 ex-showroom Delhi. The motorcycle has a four-valve engine, six-speed gearbox and ETB ride modes. This is a priced product launch; no manufacturer financing partnership or discount is claimed.
